_what: Truckin' Food Court, which everybody calls the Truck Stop: an outdoor food court on the street between the Run and the Green, a covered porch of tables in the middle and the trucks round it. Ryan Boren's brief, 2026-10-05: food trucks that each serve one thing several ways -- tacos, bánh mì, ramen and dog treats -- and a drinks truck with iced water, iced tea, lemonade, hibiscus tea, boba tea, flavoured ice, oral rehydration solutions and other things to drink when it is hot. Built by tools/make-truckin-food-court.py, which checks every item with Hey, Good Cookin's allergen engine and every drink's caffeine with Pekoe and Purrs', and every dog treat against the ASPCA's list of people foods to keep from pets.
_free: Nothing here has a price, and the tool refuses one: our Third Places entry asks for a place that provides community without being required to buy stuff, and Pekoe and Purrs' board already has no prices on it. The trucks hand things out.
_trucks: In the order they stand round the porch, left to right. Each truck's awning is two of the room's colours in stripes, and the light under it is those stripes: see §97. A truck's items lead with a vegan one, the same size as the rest, Big Steep's rule for its alcohol-free pour.

trucks.name: Tacos
trucks.lede: Every taco is on two corn tortillas warmed on the plancha, with lime and both salsas on the side: a red one of tomato and chile de árbol, and a green one of tomatillo, serrano chilli and coriander.
trucks.about: A taco is a Mexican dish: a small tortilla, corn or wheat, folded round a filling, in the words of Wikipedia's article on it.

items.name: Mushroom al pastor
items.what: oyster mushrooms marinated in achiote, guajillo chilli and pineapple juice, grilled, with pineapple, white onion and coriander, on two corn tortillas

items.name: Potato and black bean
items.what: crisp potato, black beans refried in olive oil, pickled red onion and green salsa, on two corn tortillas

items.name: Al pastor
items.what: pork shoulder marinated in achiote, guajillo chilli and pineapple juice, cooked on an upright spit and shaved, with pineapple, white onion and coriander, on two corn tortillas
items.note: Cooked on an upright spit, the way shawarma is: Wikipedia's taco article traces al pastor to Mexico's Lebanese immigrants.

items.name: Carnitas
items.what: pork shoulder braised and crisped in lard, green salsa, white onion and coriander, on two corn tortillas

items.name: Chicken tinga
items.what: chicken stewed with chipotle chilli and tomato, shredded lettuce and sour cream, on two corn tortillas

items.name: Fish, the Baja way
items.what: cod in a batter of wheat flour and sparkling water, fried, with shredded cabbage, pico de gallo and lime mayonnaise, on two corn tortillas
items.note: Fish tacos come from Baja California, Wikipedia's taco article says.

items.name: Quesabirria
items.what: beef stewed with guajillo and ancho chillies, folded with melted Oaxaca cheese and crisped on the plancha, with a cup of the broth for dipping, on two corn tortillas
items.note: Birria comes from Jalisco, where it is often goat; quesabirria, with the cheese and the broth to dip it in, from Tijuana. Wikipedia's articles on them say so. This one is beef.

trucks.name: Bánh mì
trucks.lede: Every bánh mì is a Vietnamese baguette, thin in the crust and light in the middle, with đồ chua, the pickled carrot and daikon, and cucumber, coriander and fresh chilli in it as well as what it is named for.
trucks.about: The baguette came to Vietnam under French rule from the 1860s, and the sandwich became what it is in Saigon in the 1950s, Wikipedia's article on it says. The bread may be made with rice flour as well as wheat.

items.name: Bánh mì chay
items.what: lemongrass tofu, mushroom pâté, eggless mayonnaise and soy sauce, with đồ chua, cucumber, coriander and chilli, in a baguette
items.note: Chay is vegetarian. This one is vegan all the way down, the mayonnaise included.

items.name: Bánh mì nấm
items.what: oyster mushrooms grilled with lemongrass and soy sauce, eggless mayonnaise, đồ chua, cucumber, coriander and chilli, in a baguette

items.name: Bánh mì đặc biệt
items.what: pork liver pâté, chả lụa pork roll, sliced roast pork, mayonnaise and soy sauce, with đồ chua, cucumber, coriander and chilli, in a baguette
items.note: Đặc biệt is the special, with a bit of everything from the pork side of the board.

items.name: Bánh mì thịt nướng
items.what: pork grilled with lemongrass and fish sauce, mayonnaise, đồ chua, cucumber, coriander and chilli, in a baguette

items.name: Bánh mì gà
items.what: chicken grilled with lemongrass, mayonnaise, đồ chua, cucumber, coriander and chilli, in a baguette

items.name: Bánh mì trứng
items.what: two fried eggs, soy sauce and mayonnaise, with đồ chua, cucumber, coriander and chilli, in a baguette

items.name: Bánh mì xíu mại
items.what: pork meatballs simmered in tomato sauce, with đồ chua, cucumber, coriander and chilli, in a baguette
items.note: Xíu mại is a meatball sandwich, Wikipedia says, and these are pork.

trucks.name: Ramen
trucks.lede: Every bowl is wheat noodles made with kansui, the alkaline water that makes them springy and a little yellow, in a broth flavoured with its tare.
trucks.about: Wikipedia calls ramen a Japanese-Chinese fusion noodle dish, made with Chinese-style alkaline wheat noodles. Tare is the sauce that flavours the broth: shio, salt, is the oldest of the four kinds, and miso ramen comes from Sapporo.

items.name: Miso, on kombu
items.what: ramen noodles of wheat, water and kansui, in a broth of kombu and dried shiitake with white miso tare, with fried tofu, sweetcorn, bean sprouts, spring onion and toasted sesame

items.name: Vegetable shio
items.what: ramen noodles of wheat, water and kansui, in a clear broth of kombu and vegetables with salt tare, with bok choy, bamboo shoots, nori and spring onion

items.name: Spicy sesame
items.what: ramen noodles of wheat, water and kansui, in a broth of soy milk and kombu with sesame paste and chilli oil, with minced shiitake and bok choy

items.name: Shōyu
items.what: ramen noodles of wheat, water and kansui, in chicken broth with soy sauce tare, with roast chicken, bamboo shoots, nori and spring onion

items.name: Tonkotsu
items.what: ramen noodles of wheat, water and kansui, in pork bone broth simmered for hours, with chashu pork belly, a soft-boiled egg, wood ear mushroom, nori and spring onion
items.note: Tonkotsu is pork bone, and the broth is the cloudy kind that takes all day.

items.name: Sapporo miso
items.what: ramen noodles of wheat, water and kansui, in chicken broth with red miso tare, with minced pork, sweetcorn, a pat of butter, bean sprouts and spring onion

trucks.name: Treats
trucks.lede: Everything on this truck is for a dog, and it says so on every bag. Take one across to the Run next door, where the dogs from the shelter are out, or to a dog of your own.
trucks.about: Nothing on this truck is on the ASPCA's list of people foods to keep from pets: no chocolate, coffee or caffeine, no xylitol, no grapes or raisins, no onion, garlic or chives, no milk, no nuts, no avocado, no citrus, no salt to speak of, no yeast dough or alcohol, and nothing raw. The tool that builds this board checks every bag against that list.

items.name: Pumpkin and oat biscuits
items.what: pumpkin, oat flour and plain peanut butter, baked hard
items.note: The peanut butter is peanuts and nothing else.

items.name: Sweet potato chews
items.what: sweet potato, sliced and dried slowly

items.name: Banana and peanut butter licks
items.what: banana and plain peanut butter, blended with water and frozen in a paper cup
items.note: The peanut butter is peanuts and nothing else.

items.name: Chicken jerky
items.what: chicken breast, cooked and dried, and nothing else

items.name: Beef liver bites
items.what: beef liver, baked dry and cut small

items.name: Salmon and sweet potato bites
items.what: cooked salmon, sweet potato and oat flour, baked

trucks.name: The Cooler
trucks.lede: Everything cold to drink, and plenty of ice. Every cup says what is in it and how much caffeine.
trucks.about: Agua fresca is fruit, flowers, seeds or grains blended with sugar and water, Wikipedia's article on it says, and jamaica, made with hibiscus, is one of the commonest. Shaved ice is a raspado in Mexico, kakigōri in Japan and shave ice in Hawaii.

items.name: Iced water
items.what: filtered water, over ice

items.name: Iced tea
items.what: black tea brewed strong and poured over ice, with a wedge of lemon

items.name: Lemonade
items.what: lemon juice, sugar and water, over ice

items.name: Agua de jamaica
items.what: hibiscus flowers steeped and chilled, sweetened with sugar, over ice
items.note: Hibiscus tea is made from the calyces of the roselle flower.

items.name: Agua fresca de sandía
items.what: watermelon blended with water and lime juice, over ice

items.name: Brown sugar milk tea, with boba
items.what: black tea, oat milk, brown sugar syrup and tapioca pearls, over ice
items.note: Bubble tea comes from Taiwan, in the 1980s, Wikipedia says, and the pearls are tapioca, which is cassava.

items.name: Jasmine milk tea, with boba
items.what: jasmine green tea, oat milk, cane sugar syrup and tapioca pearls, over ice

items.name: Raspado
items.what: ice shaved fine, with mango syrup, chamoy and a pinch of chilli and lime salt
items.note: Chamoy is a sauce of pickled fruit and chilli.

items.name: Oral rehydration solution
items.what: water with sodium chloride, glucose, potassium chloride and trisodium citrate, in the World Health Organization's amounts
items.note: The WHO's recipe, per litre of water: 2.6 g of sodium chloride, 13.5 g of glucose, 1.5 g of potassium chloride and 2.9 g of trisodium citrate. Plain, or with a splash of orange. Nobody at the hatch asks why you want it.

items.name: Coconut water
items.what: the water from inside young coconuts, chilled

items.name: Salted lime soda
items.what: preserved salted limes, sugar and sparkling water, over ice

_rack: Ryan's pick, of 2026-10-05, in his three shelves and his order, for the screen on the side of the Cooler. Every one was asked of its own watch page on 2026-10-05: all OK, the runtime that page's own lengthSeconds. NHK WORLD-JAPAN's RAMEN JAPAN plays and has embedding switched off, so it is a door to YouTube rather than a screen, and says why. Two of Ryan's links started part of the way in, and those carry the start, which the button says before the press. The titles are the channels' own and are not swept: the best taco in the world, a Michelin star and the most hyped bánh mì are theirs to say.
